The law is dA/dt = −(0.306·A² + 0.0718·t²), and it fits the 300 training rows to an NMSE of about 6e-24, well under the 1e-12 target.

The fitted constants are 0.306 for the A² term and 0.0718 for the t² term, in mol/(L·s) units. The two terms add with no cross-coupling.
